text_blocks.snippet: Many plants have medicinal properties and have been used traditionally to treat various diseases. Here are some examples:

list.snippet: Echinacea: Boosts the immune system and fights infections.
Turmeric: Reduces inflammation and has antioxidant properties.
Garlic: Contains allicin, which has antimicrobial and antiviral effects.
Aloe vera: Soothes skin irritations and promotes healing.
Taxol: Extracted from the bark of the Pacific yew tree, it's a potent chemotherapy agent.
Etoposide: Derived from the mandrake plant, it's used to treat various cancers.
Vinca alkaloids: Found in periwinkle plants, they inhibit cancer cell growth.
Hawthorn: Improves heart function and lowers blood pressure.
Ginkgo biloba: Enhances blood flow and cognitive function.
